title: A note on repair desk records
passage:
Service desk note | One record, two dates

The warranty summary shows when we first received each item. It does not show when a technician first tested it. If a customer brings the same item back for the same symptom, reopen the existing record, even if it has already been marked complete. The original received date will stay in the warranty summary. Write the new visit date in the notes.

For a new symptom, open a separate record. Use the same item serial number on both records, but describe the new symptom without copying the earlier diagnosis. If you are unsure whether the symptom is the same, ask the customer to describe when it happens. A familiar sound by itself is not a diagnosis.

The weekly staffing report counts each visit, even when two visits belong to one service record. It is not meant to count how many different items the desk has received.
passageZh:
維修櫃檯紀錄｜一筆紀錄與兩種日期

保固摘要顯示每件物品第一次送到櫃檯的日期，不是技師第一次測試的日期。顧客如果為同一件物品的同一症狀再送修，就重開原有紀錄，即使該筆已標為完成也一樣。保固摘要保留原收件日；請把本次到訪的日期寫進備註。

如果是新的症狀，請另開一筆紀錄。兩筆紀錄使用相同的物品序號，但請描述新症狀，不要照抄先前診斷。若不確定是否屬同一症狀，請顧客描述症狀何時出現。聽起來像先前的聲音，本身並不等於診斷。

每週人力安排報表將每次到訪各算一次，即使同一筆維修紀錄下有兩次到訪也一樣。這份報表並不是要算櫃檯總共收到幾件不同的物品。
